main_text.l: Mentiri & peierare religionis gratia, licere aiunt Priscillianistae, & Audiani.
Per creaturas iurari posse, docent Manichai.
DE QVARTO PRÆCEPTO, Memento diei sabbati, &c.
Sabbatorum obseruationem hodie necessariam putant Ebionitae, Cerinthiani, Apollinaristae.
Mosaicas ceremonias in vsum, tanquam necessarias, reuocant Ebionitae, Cerinthiani, Nazareni, Floriniani.
Sacrificia Legis retinent, adeo vt oues & boues mactent, Samosateniani, Symmachiani, Armenij, Iacobitae.
Ceremonias Legis etiam post mortem & resurrectionem vsum habituras dicunt Apollinaristae.
Deum nouis ceremoniis, & ex Paganorum ritu repetitis, colunt Papistae.
Deum corporeis exercitationibus colunt, tanquam in iis verus Dei cultus sit positus, Monachi.
Deum nouo abstinentiarum genere colunt, tanquam in iis vera sanctitas fita sit, ac quidem carne & animatis abstinent Saturniani, Ebionitae, Taciani, Manichaei, Priscillianistae, Patriciani.

page.notes: The stray mark before "Sabbatorum" and the leading symbol before "Monachi" are printer's marks, not text. The faint numeral lower left may be show-through or a page number; it is doubtful. The Latin long s is printed as f-like forms; rendered as s. The text "Abfti-" is a catchword on a half word.
